sources.title: FP8-RL: A Practical and Stable Low-Precision Stack for LLM Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by rollout (generation), where long output sequence lengths make attention and KV-cache memory dominate end-to-end step time.
